head: 805271cfaa1e2628afa4991b1669f829237bedf6
scope: Local offline lightweight smoke only; no provider calls, live review, network fetch, GitHub writes, or golden-label reads.

cli_help.interpretation: CLI help/import startup only; not PR review latency or model cost.

cached_context_build.input: ../eval-data/prepared/prepared.json and its 25 referenced pr.json/diff.patch pairs; each input SHA and metadata were verified before parsing.
cached_context_build.interpretation: Original three-run timing/RSS measurement was taken before the hunk-ledger fix and had a 1460-hunk coverage denominator. See post_fix_validation for the separate untimed verification that all 1771 source hunks now enter the hunk ledger. Cached context-builder throughput only; not full review latency.

fixed_seed_properties.inputs: Unicode combining marks, emoji, CJK, CRLF, tabs, long lines; random and fixed tiny budgets.
fixed_seed_properties.truncate_assertions: For every sample: used == count_tokens(output), count_tokens(output) <= budget, valid UTF-8 string, clipped == (count_tokens(source) > budget); unchanged source when it fits.
fixed_seed_properties.hunk_assertions: Every context sample had nonempty prompt, no unaccounted file, and hunk total == complete + partial + omitted.

artifacts: Temporary probe scripts were under /private/tmp. The later intentional hunk-accounting implementation and test changes are represented by the current working-tree diff; no dataset report was modified.

post_fix_validation.change: Early documentation, lockfile, and secret-adjacent path exclusions now count parsed diff hunks as omitted without rendering diff content.
post_fix_validation.source_state: Working tree after the hunk-ledger fix and reuse of the already parsed hunk map; no timing values are attributed to this validation.
post_fix_validation.command: Offline .venv Python probe over the same 25 prepared input pairs; verified input hashes/metadata; parse_diff + build_review_context(include_context_pack=False, allow_remote_file_fetch=False, max_patch_tokens=6000).
post_fix_validation.assertions: For each case, source parse_file_hunks count equals coverage_summary.hunks_total, which equals complete+partial+omitted; all changed files have a coverage entry. Excluded content sentinels are absent from prompt. Binary-diff and metadata-only rename examples remain zero-hunk with their existing exclusion/no-hunks reason.
post_fix_validation.observed_nonblocking_warning: One cached missing-patch file (services/copilot-review-mcp/go.sum) remained excluded as patch_unavailable because no frozen fallback file was available; remote reads were disabled.

validation.focused_tests: 22 passed: tests/test_chunk_coverage.py and tests/test_context_omissions.py, after parsed_hunks map reuse.
validation.full_pytest: 451 passed, 1 Starlette deprecation warning. This full run followed the behavioral fix and preceded only the no-behavior map-reuse simplification; the repository pre-commit hook will validate the final commit state.
validation.offline_gates: criteria 4/4; heldout witness 7/7 and equivalent 7/7; interface audit 80 files, 0 unknown kwargs and 0 inert flags.
validation.ruff: E9,F63,F7,F82 passed for the two changed Python files. E501 still reports seven pre-existing context_builder.py lines outside the new hunk-accounting block.
